# Metal's f32 answers at and around denormal operands, on an Apple M3 Max under macOS 27.0.1: our
# own kernel, built from source twice, without fast math and precise functions, then with fast math
# and fast functions. A line is the function, its operands and Metal's answers in those two builds,
# as bits. `mix` lines take every triple of 12 of the patterns; on every triple of all 28,
# `mix(a, b, c)` answered `fma(c, b, fma(-c, a, a))` word for word in both builds. `atan2` lines
# take every pair of the 28 patterns, and `sinpi`, `cospi` and `tanpi` lines each of them. `fmod`
# lines are `fast::fmod` of every pair of the 28 patterns, built the same two ways.
